searchText: What type of networking is required for the beacon chain light clients? I have finished implementing the Altair minimal spec in C# and would like to test the functionalities using real data from the beacon chain. I have looked at the source code of Lodestar's light client demo and realized it uses a mock-server. Do I have to build something similar to this?
